The Young’s modulus 𝐸SE was more sensitive at lower 𝑓CAM, while 𝐸CAM became more critical at higher 𝑓CAM, corre- sponding to the increased influence of CAM content. Poisson’s ratios for both SE (𝜈SE) and CAM (𝜈CAM) showed no significant trends, possibly due to their narrow range in literature, limiting their impact within this study. Despite pressure affecting packing and percolation behavior, the sensitivity matrices showed no significant pressure-related trends, suggesting that within the studied range, pressure variations have a limited impact compared to other factors like friction coefficients and Young’s modulus.

Poisson ratios and RC consistently had the lowest sensitivity across all cases. Overall, SE45 showed greater sensitivity to parameter variations than SE19, likely due to the lower particle size ratio 𝜆, making the system more responsive to changes in friction and mechanical proper- ties.
